description: The site has no footer. Add a consistent, styled footer to every page that helps visitors find the other pages and the source code.
acceptanceCriteria: AC1: A footer component renders on every page from the root layout, below the page content and pinned to the bottom of short pages.
AC2: It links to the chat (/), /catalog, /pipeline and the GoReactChat and agentic-pipeline GitHub repositories; external links open in a new tab with rel="noopener noreferrer".
AC3: It shows a short line saying pages on this site were built by the agentic pipeline, and the current year.
AC4: It is styled with the existing Tailwind conventions, works in light and dark mode, and stacks cleanly at phone width.
AC5: A test renders the footer and checks every link's href, and that the active page's link is marked with aria-current.
guidance: Use next/link for internal links and usePathname for the active state, in a small client component.
Keep it compact: one or two rows, muted text, a top border; no new dependency.
Do not change the chat page's layout beyond what the footer needs.
